Process & Business Automation

Workflow automation that removes manual steps and connects your tools, data, and teams.

We map your manual processes, identify automation opportunities, and build systems that run without human intervention — freeing your team for higher-value work.

Includes: Business process automation (BPA), Robotic process automation (RPA), Multi-step approval workflow engines, Data pipeline and ETL automation, Notification and alert systems, Integration between disconnected tools.

Technologies: Node.js, Python, n8n, Zapier API, REST/GraphQL, PostgreSQL.

Use cases: Workflow automation, RPA integration, Approval chains, Data pipelines.

What does Process & Business Automation include? Workflow automation that removes manual steps and connects your tools, data, and teams.

How does AICORE scope this kind of project? We start with discovery, define the users and data flows, map integrations, identify delivery risks, and then propose a phased build plan with clear milestones.

Can this integrate with our existing systems? Yes. AICORE designs solutions around existing tools, APIs, databases, devices, and operational workflows wherever possible.
